# EML Attachment Remover 3.0.1

This corrective release hardens the MIME-pruned working-copy pipeline introduced in
v3.0.0. It strengthens raw MIME ownership checks, RFC 2231 and comment parsing,
independent candidate verification, native output receipts, and generated-property
evidence. It preserves v3's safety boundary: retained `text/plain` and `text/html`
payloads remain source bytes, only explicitly authorized attachment or related
non-root subtrees are removed, and ambiguous input is rejected rather than guessed.
Retain originals and regenerate any v2-derived files from those originals.

Verify downloaded artifacts before installation:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify remove-eml-attachments.pyz --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```
